name: vlds
description: VLDS — a standalone, runtime epistemic layer: a user-controlled dashboard for a model's own epistemics. Four instruments. The gate routes a load-bearing claim through VERIFIABLE → VERIFIED → CONFIRMED / PENDING / HEDGED, so an action proceeds only on a verified claim and an unverifiable one is stated with its uncertainty attached; it tracks each claim's provenance through a neural-net model and classifies it by storage durability. The guide loop disciplines the need behind the claim — asking when it must, reusing what the user already configured, and recording both to an auditable ledger. The inspector re-examines a load-bearing verdict through independent perspectives — blind to the original reasoning, re-grounded in sources — routing it to CORROBORATED, REJECTED, or CONTESTED, reconstructing from outside the calibrated confidence the model cannot read off itself. The gc is a garbage collector for belief state — stored rules, memories, and training-data assumptions are marked LIVE / STALE / FREED-RESIDUE / UNOWNED by tracing provenance to a live root, swept transitively on a user retraction, compacted (the lesson survives, the directive dies), and tombstoned so the same garbage is not re-learned. The four instruments are invoked directly; a fifth skill, the looper, surfaces on its own and runs them in order, logging each decision to a shared, user-editable log. A SessionStart memory override extends the built-in per-project memory system the way a derived class overrides a virtual method — base read/write untouched, the VLDS store (index, ledger, logger, tombstones) living in the working directory's .claude/vlds/ directory, created if absent, with the pre-override repo-root .vlds/ read as a legacy source. The gate's storage tiers persist to per-tier partition files (virtual, session-storage, local-storage, data-store), each with its own entry schema and a lazy expiry enforced at recall — no partition invalidates itself, so the collector owns their invalidation and marks a closed-scope entry EXPIRED, freed without a tombstone. The gc guards three barriers in all: read (what is recalled), write (what is stored), and dispatch — the last checking, as the thought stream forms, whether a message is being addressed a second time (FRESH / ECHO / SUPERSEDED) so an echo is answered as a delta and a superseded message surfaces its free instead of being acted on. Standalone; no external plugin dependencies.
